title: Composition isomorphisms of derived direct images (conjugates of those of inverse images)
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$ and $v:Z\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the derived direct images $Ru_*,Rv_*,R(u\circ v)_*$ on the bounded below derived categories of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the adjunctions $u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction] (for $u$, $v$, $u\circ v$ and $\mathrm{id}_X$), and the composition and identity isomorphisms $c^D_{u,v}:v^{-1}u^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(u\circ v)^{-1}$, $e^D_X:\mathrm{id}_X^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ of the derived inverse images [lem-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-composition]. The *composition isomorphism of derived direct images*
$$
 d^D_{u,v}:R(u\circ v)_*\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Ru_*\circ Rv_*
$$
is the conjugate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] of $c^D_{u,v}$ with respect to the adjunction $(u\circ v)^{-1}\dashv R(u\circ v)_*$ and the composite adjunction $v^{-1}u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*Rv_*$ (unit $Ru_*\eta^D_vu^{-1}\circ\eta^D_u$, counit $\varepsilon^D_v\circ v^{-1}\varepsilon^D_uRv_*$); and the *identity isomorphism* $d^D_X:R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ is the conjugate of $e^D_X$ with respect to $\mathrm{id}_X^{-1}\dashv R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*$ and the identity adjunction $\mathrm{id}\dashv\mathrm{id}$. Both are isomorphisms because $c^D_{u,v}$, $e^D_X$ are [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. Explicitly, $d^D_{u,v,K}$ is the composite $R(uv)_*K\xrightarrow{\eta}Ru_*Rv_*v^{-1}u^{-1}R(uv)_*K\xrightarrow{Ru_*Rv_*c^D_{u,v}}Ru_*Rv_*(uv)^{-1}R(uv)_*K\xrightarrow{Ru_*Rv_*\varepsilon^D_{uv,K}}Ru_*Rv_*K$, $\eta$ the unit of the composite adjunction.

source.place: Lemma 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition, line 4011) and its proof: $Rg_*\circ Rf_*$ is right adjoint to $Lf^*\circ Lg^*=L(g\circ f)^*$ (Lemma 0D6D), hence equal to $R(g\circ f)_*$ by uniqueness of adjoints
